name: Darkshard

abilities.name: Swipe
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Terrorizing Strike
abilities.description: Darkshard winds up a heavy strike, with a deceiving time before the animation and the strike, dealing very high physical damage and staggering. This can be blocked.

abilities.name: Feast
abilities.description: Darkshard shrieks loudly, indicated by a wide red cone, dealing high physical damage and snaring affected targets.

abilities.name: Grasping Scream
abilities.description: Darkshard shoots dark projectiles at nearby targets, dealing low magical damage and stunning them. If Break Free is not used, stunned targets are pulled to Darkshard, who then summons a negate field, indicated by a large red circle, dealing continuous high magical damage.

abilities.name: Maelstrom Summon
abilities.description: At certain health threshold, Darkshard vanishes from the arena and summons bosses from Maelstrom Arena to fight in its stead. At the 80% threshold, Maxus the Many is summoned. At 60%, the Champion of Atrocity and at 40%, the Argonian Behemoth (along with Argonian Venomcallers in Hard Mode).

abilities.name: Summon Shade
abilities.description: After "Terrorizing Strike" and "Scream", a shadowy version of Darkshard spawns at a faraway target and performs those abilities again.

related_quests: The Forgotten Vault: Defend the Maelstrom's Bedlam Veil from an invading army.
Pledge: Bedlam Veil: Explore Bedlam Veil and return Undaunted.
summary: Darkshard is a Shardborn mind terror that serves as the second boss of Bedlam Veil.
